announcements.title: Welcome to Z0025E Computer Networks!
announcements.text: Welcome to Z0025E Computer Networks / Datorkommunikation ! The course starts this week, and the first lecture will take place on 17 September at 14:30 via Zoom . You can find the Zoom link and other course information in Canvas. Before we meet for the first lecture, please take some time to familiarise yourself with the Canvas course room and get started with the 🧠 Pre-Knowledge module . The Pre-Knowledge module contains a short overview followed by several 2-minute Pre-Knowledge Checks covering topics that we will encounter later in the course. These activities are not graded . announcements.title: Welcome to Week 2
announcements.text: Dear All, Welcome to Week 2 of Z0025E Computer Networks! This week is a self-paced learning week . There are no scheduled lectures. Instead, you should work through Lecture 2 and Lecture 3 independently in Canvas . The two lectures continue our introduction to computer networks before moving into the Application Layer . Please work through the lecture material, reflection questions, Knowledge Checks, and associated learning activities provided on each Canvas page. announcements.title: Welcome to Week 3
announcements.text: Dear All, Welcome to Week 3 of Z0025E Computer Networks! This week we return to our scheduled lectures on Zoom and continue with the Application Layer before beginning our study of the Transport Layer . We will cover Lecture 4 and Lecture 5 , building on the self-paced material from last week. We also have Lab 2 on Friday . Please remember to sign up for a lab assessment session in Canvas before Friday . Week 3 Outlook 🎓 Monday, 28 September – Lecture 4 (09:00–10:30, Zoom).
